svg.text: Workflow-orchestrated, event-driven pipeline · Cloud Run + Cloud Functions + Pub/Sub + BigQuery + Firestore · least-privilege IAM
1. POST (OIDC) to cr-registration-ingest and assert body.status == "success"
2. Poll BigQuery until the published customers are in trx_customer_notification (max ~5 min)
3. Start sq_generate_synthetic_enrollment and poll every 10 s → SUCCEEDED
4. Start sq_evaluate_customer_segment and poll every 10 s → SUCCEEDED
5. POST (OIDC) to cf-route-customer-decision with evaluation_started_at (this run only)
one service account per component type · least privilege · default Compute and App Engine accounts without roles
2 automatic event legs triggered in cascade · $0/month on the GCP free tier · scales to zero · all config via environment variables
